title: E0083: Open redirect
plain_english: Redirecting users to a URL supplied in the request without validating where it goes can allow attackers to craft phishing links that appear to come from your domain.
why_matters: Open redirect vulnerabilities are commonly used in: - **Phishing campaigns**: users trust your domain and click the link - **Bypassing SSO protections**: redirecting after login to a malicious site - **Credential harvesting**: the malicious site mimics a trusted page
